# CANDIDATE: VIX_INTRADAY_SPIKE_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-22  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A sudden intraday VIX spike (>15% from open) often precedes a short-term mean-reversion in SPY, providing a short opportunity when price is above VWAP. This edge exists because VIX spikes reflect panic-driven volatility expansion that tends to reverse as liquidity returns and dealers re-hedge, creating a fade opportunity in the underlying index.

## Mechanism

Calculate % change in VIX from open to current 5-min bar. Enter short when: VIX ↑ ≥15% within 30 min of open, SPY price > VWAP, and current 5-min bar is bearish (close < open) with volume ≥ 1.3× average 5-min volume. Exit: stop at VWAP level (chart-stop), target at 1×ATR below entry, runner trails at 15% of ATR. Regime filter: only trade when opening VIX < 15 (avoid high-VIX environments where spikes are less informative).
